comments.comment: I am on this video because for a couple or a few years now, my living partner doesn't let me sleep and I am just filled with rage this morning after another night of it. What was said at 1:40 perfectly was validating because it's exactly why I'm here. I work mornings and my partner works nights. I typically wake up at sunrise, before my alarm so I need to go to bed at least a few hours before midnight for a chance at undisturbed rest. We don't get a lot of quality time together so I understand that they want to hang out so badly, but I expressed to them that Im working extra hours today, but they wanted to keep hanging out and we end up being awake 4 more hours after i was already prepared to go to bed and I got maybe 4-5 hours of sleep. This happens regularly. I dont know how to make them understand that this affects my capability to be a good partner and person in  general. It affects my life. All I want to do is sleep on my free time, like on my days off or during the afternoons, rather than at night. I have such a hard time focusing, getting things done, and forming and maintaining relationships with other people. Im unbelievably upset at the situation and myself. I have an incredibly low image of myself because I feel like my cup is constantly empty when it comes to people i care about. My inner thoughts toward myself are not kind. It makes me want to be destructive, and break something or hurt myself. i continuously don't act out the emotion but i feel it so often. im concerned im going to develop an autoimmune disease. I used to have an outlet for rage through martial arts and exercise(Shaun T Insanity workouts, weightlifting, cycling, or running), but Im so exhausted that I just choose to catch up on rest. I dont know how to explain this to actually be heard and not come across as batshit. Anyways I googled "i need suggestions for channeling rage" and wound up here on this video. after watching, i still don't know what to do. like i feel that i am very much experiencing this emotion. i know of a solution, but my access to the solution(s) are obstructed. am i already doing what gabor is suggesting in this video? just experiencing it? cause again, i am, and i truly feel miserable often
